The products page had a duplicated "Sunset Mug" card, which left a seventh card alone on the last row of the three-column grid. I removed the duplicate in `site/products.html`. The grid is now two full rows of three, and the 16 functional tests pass.

The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't tell which change introduced the problem. I picked the duplicate because it was the visible defect in a screenshot of the page.

Two smaller things I noticed and left alone. The cards in a row have slightly different heights, so the price and "Add to cart" rows don't line up when a title or description wraps. The badges also sit 10px outside the card corner. If either is what you meant, tell me what you're seeing and I'll fix it.

STATUS: DONE
